_comment: PERSONAL WORDS LIVE HERE — Ames, this file is for Navi to edit.
Keys you probably want to make your own: hero.personal and closing.message.
Keep the same keys in zh.json so both language modes stay in sync.
'Ames' and 'Navi' are names — they stay in Latin letters in both modes.

hero.title: Happy Mid-Autumn, Ames
hero.personal: We met not long ago — but friendship works like the moon: never in a hurry, just growing a little rounder every night.

stage.formation: made of light, warmth, and a little bit of friendship

change.name: Chang'e · 嫦娥
change.text: She drank the elixir of immortality and floated all the way to the moon, forever apart from everyone she loved. Ever since, people look up together — because under this same moon, no one is truly far away.

cross.title: the shape of reunion
cross.text: Round, like the full moon — in Chinese, 圆 (yuán) means both “round” and “together again”. And the golden center? That's the salted egg yolk: the moon itself, hiding inside.

closing.shi: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
closing.shiNote: — Su Shi, a thousand-year-old wish for the people we miss
closing.title: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival, Ames
closing.message: Thank you for finding your way into my year. Tonight the moon is exactly the same above both of us — so eat something sweet, look up once, and save me a mooncake. (Burgers still count as festival food, as long as you eat them under the moon.)
